text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Autumn) is finally about to 
begin. Aiming for the greatest finale, 
Fine Motion vows to run a race that will 
linger in everyone's hearts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy rejoiced at being able to 
run with her again. She then said that 
while the end of a story is bittersweet, 
it also marks the beginning of a brand-new 
one...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Which of them will etch their name into 
this story as the victor? The curtain 
rises on the battle now—!
